purpose: Prevent odds-only completion claims and unrecoverable validation gaps for Nov21-22. Reuse existing approved original collectors; do not modify the live schedule.
overall_evaluation_rule: No assertion of comprehensive pre-race predictive-data acquisition until categories have separate evidence, completeness and missingness receipts. Market odds alone are not sufficient. A missing source may remain unavailable despite operational attempts; preserve successful originals and status rather than block all.

categories.description: 12 races, runners, horse number, frame number, name, race times, official profile navigation, jockey, assigned weight
categories.evidence_rule: Only observed official pre-race original + SHA/UTC; retain all partial originals

categories.description: Horse sex, age, trainer, parentage and history profile HTML/parsed records
categories.evidence_rule: No guessed profile link; pre-start cutoff; report verified_count/expected; partial originals preserved

categories.description: Past runs, time-series features, results prior to race start
categories.evidence_rule: Exclude post-cutoff races; track unresolved rows and missing profiles

categories.description: Scheduled jockey and assigned carry weight
categories.evidence_rule: Source-verified current jockey distinct from prior jockey; do not synthesize
Save observed value or explicit MISSING with original SHA and UTC

categories.description: Body mass and change per horse
categories.evidence_rule: May not be published early; preserve missingness; no future data leakage
Current code explicitly says independent source unverified; never report collected

categories.description: Pre-start 馬連 odds, market state and originals
categories.evidence_rule: Observed official market link, original SHA/UTC, pre-start sale checks

categories.description: Pre-start 枠連 odds, market state and originals
categories.evidence_rule: Observed official market link, original SHA/UTC, pre-start sale checks

categories.description: Official finish order, winning combinations and payout figures
categories.evidence_rule: Collect only when results officially final; never use in pre-race features

categories.description: Distance/course suitability, form trend, pace, growth, rest, odds distortion, model calibration
categories.existing_sources: Existing ALG01-13 design; derived feature layer
categories.evidence_rule: Derived only from frozen pre-race originals and source timestamps

critical_cross_checks: Every candidate feature must have a pre-race cutoff, matching day/race/horse identity, source SHA256 and captured UTC.
Record per race and horse completeness, explicit reason for missing/unpublished/parse failure, and independently preserve successful original bytes even if another source fails.
Do not label G04/G05 multi-data acquired solely on basis of G03/G06 odds or 12-race slot workflow passing.

At present G04 and G05 run after G03 all-12 complete: if G03 incomplete, preserve originals and report G04/G05 not executed; do not equate that with no data available; inspect as a prospective capture improvement without delaying Nov21-22 or changing pinned code unsafely.
Post-result final results and payout data never treated as pre-race information.
Workout independently observed source is not established in current G05 code: explicit unresolved gap.
Multi-source PC/SP and supplementary source support is a requirement; do not infer official SP URLs from PC; record source-specific proof.
11/21 and 11/22 live run receipts need per-category results, not only aggregated odds success.
protected: Dedicated production Turso and lab isolation
